# Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the shared repository guide before
making changes. It defines the migration goal, module boundaries, parity
constraints, test commands and safety rules.

Read the relevant [architecture decisions](../docs/decisions/README.md) and
guides from the [documentation hub](../docs/README.md), including the feature
assessment linked from the shared guide. Treat dated migration plans as
historical intent, not proof of the current implementation.

Keep repository guidance in `AGENTS.md` and decision records rather than
duplicating it here. Do not assume Markdown links automatically load their
targets; open the relevant files when they are not already in context.
